Backup Bank Review V1 closes 122 normalized Surface 24 records seeded from the Backup Manager exhaustive spec, Backup & Restore Semantics, the BACKUP-* architecture profiles, the archive encryption/key recovery model and #603 readiness evidence after a zero-unresolved WordPress native audit and market audit (UpdraftPlus, BackWPup, Duplicator, WPvivid; Jetpack VaultPress Backup, BlogVault, All-in-One WP Migration, Solid Backups, restic, BorgBackup, AWS S3 integrity/Object Lock, NIST SP 800-34, RFC 9106, Zip Slip and RFC 4253 specialists), zero semantic overlaps and zero post-market record delta. Manifest and SHA-256 checksums are mandatory, archive encryption is reviewed AEAD with recovery material never stored beside the archive, credentials are Vault references only, destructive restore requires preflight, a verified source, explicit confirmation and a pre-restore point by default, and archives are never exposed through public URLs; 24 unsafe patterns stay rejected and 10 items (DR bootstrap, KMS keys, incremental chains, logical content backup, DB objects, imports, conversions, auto-mirror, V3 scheduling, environment restrictions) are deferred. This promotes planning/Bank truth only; capture, archive, upload and restore execution remain unpromoted.

Import/Export Bank Review V1 closes 188 normalized Surface 26 records seeded from the Import/Export exhaustive spec, the Portable Configuration Package Format, the Source Migration Adapter Registry and #605 readiness evidence after a zero-unresolved WordPress native audit and market audit (WordPress Importer (WXR) + Tools Export, WP All Import, WP All Export, WP Ultimate CSV Importer; Customizer Export/Import, Widget Importer & Exporter, Import and export users and customers, WooCommerce Product CSV Importer and Exporter, WP Migrate, OWASP CSV Injection, OWASP XML External Entity Prevention Cheat Sheet, OWASP Deserialization Cheat Sheet, OWASP File Upload Cheat Sheet, RFC 4180 CSV Format specialists), zero semantic overlaps and zero post-market record delta. Configuration packages carry a versioned manifest, stable UUIDs, checksums, dependency edges and credential placeholders with secrets excluded; every import treats content as untrusted (structure/checksum/schema validation, size and archive limits, JSON-only payloads with no PHP object deserialization or code execution, private non-executable storage, Safe HTTP for remote sources) and runs inspect, compatibility, conflict mapping, semantic diff and dry run before a capability + nonce gated apply, with destructive replace and overwrite-all never default; data imports default to create-only with ownership-marker-scoped synchronize, report rollback coverage before execution and keep AI to analyze/preview; exports exclude passwords, hashes, tokens and secrets, redact PII by privacy class and escape spreadsheet formulas by default. 22 unsafe patterns stay rejected and 6 items (Encrypted Secret Transfer Mode, Concurrent Import Workers, Certified Password Hash Migration, Export From Current Admin Filtered List Snapshot, Blueprint Sample Data, Persisted Deferred Package Objects) are deferred. This promotes planning/Bank truth only; import, export and package execution remain unpromoted.
